pr_title: Port fixed version of Lucene Tessellator into ES 7.17
pr_body:
Port fixed version of Lucene Tessellator into ES

The 8.11 branch of Lucene might not get a release with the fixes for a long time, so we have ported the fixes into ES temporarily.
This required partial parts of LatLonShape also, which ES GeoShapeIndexer uses to access the tessellator for indexing.
We also copied in all tests for the two classes, as well as made a test that will fail when the Lucene version gets fixed, so we know when to delete all this temporary code.

Lucene issues:

* LUCENE-9580
* LUCENE-10470
* LUCENE-10563

Fixes #88014

issue_context.title: Tessellation issue with ES 7.17
issue_context.body:
### Elasticsearch Version

7.17

### Installed Plugins

_No response_

### Java Version

_bundled_

### OS Version

Linux 5.10.0-13-amd64 #1 SMP Debian 5.10.106-1 (2022-03-17) x86_64 GNU/Linux

### Problem Description

Some polygons with holes raise a tessellation error from Lucene ("Unable to tessellate ... Possible malformed shape detected").

This error has been fixed in ES 8.0/Lucene 9.0 (see https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/LUCENE-9580), but I think the fix should be backported somehow to ES 7.17 (in my personal case, I will have to live some more time before a migration to ES 8 could be planned).

I've attached an example shape that causes the issue (additionnally to the one found in Lucene's anti regression test)
[example_anonymized.geojson.txt](https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/files/8976569/example_anonymized.geojson.txt)

I've opened a PR on Lucene for the corresponding backport: https://github.com/apache/lucene-solr/pull/2664

How could this be backported to ES 7.17.x ?

### Steps to Reproduce

Create a new index and index the attached document, ES should return a tessellation exception

### Logs (if relevant)

_No response_
